name: Textile fragment
summary: This fragment is part of a group of Chinese silks in the V&A collection, broadly dated between the late thirteenth century and the mid-fifteenth century, and supposedly were found in Egypt. The one shown here, in blue damask, appears to be a section of a garment, presumably the side seam with a gore
